label: Cyberattack
summary: A cyberattack uses digital tools to steal information or disrupt devices and services.

items.label: Use unique passwords, extra sign-in verification, and updates
items.body: Avoid unexpected links; contact your bank promptly if money is stolen.

items.label: Protect accounts and devices
items.body: Passwords, updates, scams, and basic cybersecurity steps.

items.label: Get the free NYC Secure phone app
items.body: Alerts about some device, app, and Wi-Fi risks. An extra tool alongside good account security.

items.label: Report an internet or technology complaint
items.body: Complaints about scams, apps, and technology. If money is stolen, also contact your bank immediately.
